exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 An Earthquake News Report
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Anchor: We are now joined by our reporter near the disaster area. What can you tell us?
Reporter: A strong earthquake hit the city early this morning.
Anchor: Do we know the magnitude?
Reporter: Yes, it reached a magnitude of seven point eight.
Anchor: How are the rescue teams doing?
Reporter: Soldiers and doctors are digging out people who are trapped.
Anchor: What do the survivors need most?
Reporter: They need clean water, food and shelter right now.
exercises.translation_cn: 主播连线灾区记者;记者说今早一场强震袭击城市;震级7.8;救援队中士兵和医生正挖出被困者;幸存者最需要的是干净的水、食物和避难所。

questions.stem: When did the earthquake hit the city?
What was the magnitude of the quake?
Who are digging out the trapped people?
What do the survivors need most right now?
Where is the reporter speaking from?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 The City That Rose Again
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: In 1976, a deadly earthquake destroyed almost all of Tangshan.
In less than a minute, a large city lay in ruins.
But hope was not lost after the quake.
Soldiers, doctors and workers came from all over the country to help.
With great effort, a new Tangshan was built upon the ruins.
exercises.translation_cn: 1976年一场致命地震几乎摧毁了整个唐山;不到一分钟,大城市成了废墟;但震后希望未灭;来自全国的士兵、医生和工人前来帮忙;凭着巨大努力,一座新唐山在废墟上建起。

questions.stem: What happened to Tangshan in 1976?
options: A deadly earthquake destroyed most of it.

questions.stem: How fast did the city fall into ruins?
What does the passage say about hope after the quake?
Who came to help the city?
options: Soldiers, doctors and workers from all over the country.

questions.stem: What was finally built upon the ruins?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Making an Emergency Kit
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Student: Mrs Fors, what should we keep in an emergency kit?
Mrs Fors: First, enough water and food for three days.
Student: What about when the power goes out?
Mrs Fors: Keep a flashlight and a radio so you can hear the news.
Student: Should we have anything for injuries?
Mrs Fors: Yes, always keep a first aid kit on hand.
Student: And if we are trapped after a quake?
Mrs Fors: Tap on a pipe or use a whistle so we can find you.
exercises.translation_cn: 学生问 Fors 女士应急包里放什么;先是三天的水和食物;停电时备手电和收音机听新闻;受伤要备急救箱;若被困,敲管子或吹哨子好让人找到你。

questions.stem: How much water and food should a kit hold?
Why keep a flashlight and a radio?
options: For when the power goes out and to hear the news.

questions.stem: What should you keep for injuries?
What should a trapped person do?
options: Tap on a pipe or use a whistle.

questions.stem: Who is giving the advice?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 During an Earthquake
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: If an earthquake happens while you are indoors, do not run outside at once.
Remember three words: drop, cover and hold on.
Get under a strong table and protect your head.
If you are outdoors, move to an open space away from buildings.
Most importantly, try to stay calm during the shaking.
exercises.translation_cn: 若室内地震,别立刻往外跑;记住三个词:伏地、遮挡、稳住;躲到结实的桌子下并护住头;若在室外,到远离建筑的开阔地;最重要的是摇晃时保持镇静。

questions.stem: What should you NOT do if a quake happens indoors?
What three words should you remember?
Where should you go if you are outdoors?
options: An open space away from buildings.

questions.stem: What should you protect when under a table?
What is the most important thing during the shaking?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 A Survivor's Story
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Reporter: You survived the earthquake. How did you feel that night?
Woman: I was in shock. Everything happened so fast.
Reporter: How did you escape from your home?
Woman: I ran out before the walls fell down.
Reporter: How were you finally rescued?
Woman: A rescue worker heard me tapping on a pipe.
Reporter: What do you want to say to those who helped?
Woman: I will always be grateful to them for saving my life.
exercises.translation_cn: 记者问女幸存者那晚的感受;她说很震惊,一切发生得太快;她在墙塌前跑了出来;后来救援人员听见她敲管子的声音;她对救命之人永远感激。

questions.stem: How did the woman feel that night?
How did she escape from her home?
options: She ran out before the walls fell.

questions.stem: How was she finally rescued?
options: A worker heard her tapping on a pipe.

questions.stem: What does she feel towards those who helped?
Who is asking the questions?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 A Tip for Disaster Safety
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip that may one day save your life.
Before any disaster, make a family safety plan.
Decide where to meet if you are not together.
Keep an emergency kit ready at home.
A little preparation today can make a big difference tomorrow.
exercises.translation_cn: 一个也许能救命的小贴士:任何灾难前,做一个家庭安全计划;约好走散后在哪会合;在家备好应急包;今天的一点准备,明天会有大不同。

questions.stem: What is the tip mainly about?
What should a family decide in advance?
options: Where to meet if not together.

questions.stem: What should be kept ready at home?
When should you make these preparations?
What can a little preparation today do?
